questions.q: Does factoring help businesses expand without taking on debt?
questions.a: Absolutely. Unlike a loan, factoring doesn't add debt to your balance sheet or require long-term repayments. Instead, it converts your accounts receivable into immediate cash, giving you financial flexibility while keeping your business financially healthy.

questions.q: How does factoring compare to traditional business loans for funding growth?
questions.a: Factoring is faster, more flexible, and doesn't require collateral like a traditional loan. There's no long approval process, no monthly payments, and no restrictions on how you use the funds. Plus, because approval is based on your customers' credit, factoring is accessible to businesses that may not qualify for traditional financing.

questions.q: What if my business is growing fast - can factoring scale with me?
questions.a: Yes. Factoring is one of the most scalable funding solutions available. As your business grows and you generate more invoices, your access to funding grows too. There's no need to renegotiate credit limits or wait for approvals - you get funding as soon as your invoices are submitted.

faqs.q: How can factoring help my business grow?
faqs.a: Factoring gives you immediate access to cash from unpaid invoices, allowing you to reinvest in your business without waiting for customers to pay. Whether you need to hire more staff, expand your services, or take on bigger contracts, factoring ensures you have the working capital to scale confidently.

faqs.q: Can I use factoring to take on larger contracts or new customers?
faqs.a: Yes. A major challenge for growing businesses is waiting on payments while taking on bigger projects. Factoring bridges that gap, ensuring you have the funds to cover upfront costs, payroll, and materials - so you can confidently pursue new opportunities without cash flow concerns.

faqs.q: How fast can funding come through?
faqs.a: Approvals are fast and funding can come through in as little as 24 hours. Same-day funding is available.

faqs.q: Will factoring improve my ability to negotiate better terms with suppliers and customers?
faqs.a: Yes. With steady cash flow from factoring, you can pay suppliers on time - or even early - giving you leverage to negotiate better pricing and terms. Customers may also be more willing to work with you when they see you have the financial stability to support larger orders or longer payment cycles.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get set up and start factoring my invoices?
faqs.a: Most businesses are set up in under 24 hours. You complete an online application, provide basic business documents, and start submitting invoices.

faqs.q: How are fees and pricing determined?
faqs.a: Pricing is based on your invoice volume, the creditworthiness of your customers, and whether the agreement is recourse or non-recourse. There are no hidden fees.

faqs.q: Do I have to factor all of my invoices once I have signed a contract?
faqs.a: No. You choose which invoices to factor, as long as they meet the eligibility criteria.

faqs.q: Can I work with multiple factoring companies at the same time?
faqs.a: No. Factoring with JOBE Services is exclusive for the invoices you submit to us.

faqs.q: Does factoring require a personal or business credit check?
faqs.a: Approval depends mainly on the creditworthiness of your customers, though your business history may be reviewed as part of setting up the account.

faqs.q: How do you interact with my customers to collect payment?
faqs.a: We communicate with your customers professionally, much as your own billing department would, and we follow up on invoices that are slow to pay.

faqs.q: What happens if my customer does not pay their invoice?
faqs.a: Under a recourse agreement you buy back or replace the invoice. Under non-recourse, we typically absorb the loss, including where the customer becomes insolvent.

faqs.q: Does factoring work if my revenue is seasonal?
faqs.a: Yes. You can factor heavily through your peak season and scale back when demand drops - it is flexible, so you can use it regularly or only when cash flow is tight.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay taxes on the receivables I factor?
faqs.a: Receivables are taxed as revenue when they are earned, and factoring itself creates no extra tax obligation. Check the details with your accountant.

faqs.q: What happens if I have a question or need support with my account?
faqs.a: You get direct access to a dedicated account manager rather than a call centre.

facts.heading: From Humble beginnings
facts.text: Founded in 1996 in Humble, Texas, Jobe has spent three decades helping businesses stay in motion. From its roots serving trucking, oil and gas, and other industries across Texas and neighboring states, it has built a reputation for personalized service and reliability. When the founding family retired, CEO Jonathon Tupper acquired Jobe and the same trusted team remained in place.

facts.text: Based in Humble, Texas, with roots serving trucking, oil and gas and other industries across Texas and neighboring states. Today JOBE Services funds businesses nationwide.
